notes: Dynamax Desktop v3.1.27 packages the latest desktop source for all editions. Its shared online procurement workspace now includes quantity-available imports with repeat-upload protection, bulk department assignment, select-all purchase and supply requests with individual quantities and purchase unit costs, and compact tables with aligned stock values. Includes the existing finance, academic, approval and reporting improvements. Procurement changes require the current companion backend and an internet connection. Installing this update does not change existing stock, balances, approval paths or student scores.
